claim: An intraday momentum strategy on SPY (2007-2024) using an opening-range breakout rule with a volatility-scaled noise band and trailing stop returns 19.6% annualized net of costs, Sharpe 1.33.
impact_on_spec: Direct precedent for a volatility-filtered trend-continuation rule on a single liquid ETF (QQQ here); motivates using a realized-volatility-scaled threshold rather than a fixed percentage band.
limitations: This is intraday/opening-range, not the daily-bar trend-continuation idea being drafted here; the volatility-scaling principle transfers, the specific entry timing does not. Treat as directional evidence for the mechanism family, not a template to copy bar-for-bar.

claim: Parameter optimization and alternative exit rules materially change intraday momentum strategy performance versus the base Zarattini/Aziz/Barbon rule.
impact_on_spec: Warns that this strategy family is sensitive to exit-rule choice, which is exactly the kind of researcher-degree-of-freedom this project's effective-N clustering and preregistered search space exist to price honestly rather than tune away.
limitations: Reinforces treating exit-rule variants as part of the SAME mechanism family (one cluster) rather than as independent trials, per open_composer.research.kernel.effective_trials.

claim: A structural leakage-safe, search-aware evaluation harness rejected every LLM-discovered strategy across two frontier models, up to 100 candidates, 5 runs; passive benchmarks were certified with OOS confidence intervals excluding zero. Deflated Sharpe alone is insufficient -- a deliberately leaky oracle scoring Sharpe 35 survives DSR and PBO testing completely.
impact_on_spec: Directly validates this project's own design choice to combine preregistered gates (config/promotion/kernel-paper-tier-gates.json) with structural anti-lookahead checks (assert_causal_transform) rather than relying on DSR/PBO as a sufficient statistic; also validates the plan's premise that a simple, pre-registered, literature-grounded mechanism has a lower evidential bar than a searched one.
limitations: This is the single most load-bearing external source for the whole goal-first plan's search-vs-preregistration framing, not just this iteration -- it should be re-cited whenever a new search round is justified.

claim: Centered temporal features and same-day-open execution using post-open daily-bar information cause large, stable inflation in both predictive and trading metrics; a clean t+1-open execution reference isolates this decision-time leakage.
impact_on_spec: This project's backtest engine already enforces signal_on=bar_close / fill_assumption=next_bar_open as the ONLY legal values (open_composer/models/strategy_spec.py ExecutionConfig) -- this paper is independent external confirmation that convention is the right one, not an arbitrary constraint.
limitations: No design change needed; recorded because it is direct evidence the project's existing hard-coded execution convention is a leakage-safety feature, worth citing if that constraint is ever questioned.

claim: ChronoBERT/ChronoGPT, trained only on text available as of each historical cutoff, achieve Sharpe ratios in a next-day-return-from-news task comparable to a much larger general LLM, indicating lookahead bias from using knowledge-cutoff-mismatched LLMs on historical news is modest but present.
impact_on_spec: Not used in this iteration (QQQ daily trend/volatility factors only, no LLM/news factor), but directly relevant to this project's broader AI-information-supplement goal: any future news/LLM factor round must record the scoring model's knowledge cutoff in the feature packet per AGENTS.md's PIT requirement.
limitations: Recorded as forward-looking context per the goal-first plan's own instruction to survey frontier AI-quant practice broadly, not narrowly to this one iteration's factor list.

claim: Statistical jump models (explicit jump penalization, likelihood-free) produce more persistent, less falsely-alarming bull/bear regime labels than Gaussian Hidden Markov Models on daily equity return/risk features, and the jump-model-guided strategy reduces volatility and drawdown versus both an HMM-guided strategy and buy-and-hold.
impact_on_spec: Not implemented in this iteration's simple SMA/momentum entry rule, but is the literature basis noted in the capability gap analysis (docs/capability-gap-analysis-2026-09-02.zh.md) for a future shared regime-detection data product, superior to this project's current ad hoc per-strategy threshold rules.
limitations: Confirms the gap-analysis recommendation rather than changing this iteration's search space; flagged in candidate_matrix_revisions as an explicitly deferred enhancement, not silently dropped.

claim: RD-Agent(Q) jointly optimizes factors and models through a hypothesis-generation / code-generation / backtest-feedback loop, reporting roughly 2x annualized return versus classical factor libraries while using 70% fewer factors.
impact_on_spec: Not implemented here (this iteration uses the existing factor_library.py catalog via oc research auto's keyword/LLM factor selection, not a hypothesis-generation agent), but is the primary literature precedent motivating the capability-gap analysis's recommendation to add hypothesis-first LLM factor generation as a P0 item, since the project's plain genetic-programming search was independently shown to fit noise (docs/review-kernel-search-2026-09-01.zh.md section 3.3).
limitations: This iteration deliberately stays inside the existing deterministic factor-catalog path rather than attempting the RD-Agent pattern, since that is out of this week's scope; recorded so a future iteration does not re-derive this literature basis from scratch.

claim: SEC approved FINRA's elimination of the Pattern Day Trader designation on 2026-04-14, effective 2026-06-04 (FINRA Regulatory Notice 26-10): the PDT designation, day-trade count test, and $25,000 minimum equity requirement are eliminated, replaced by an intraday margin monitoring framework; Reg T 50%/25% margin still applies and cash accounts remain on T+1 settlement.
impact_on_spec: This QQQ daily-bar candidate is unaffected (one trade per signal, not day-trading), but the fact is recorded because it changes the operating constraints for any future minute-bar/intraday candidate this project builds -- frequent same-day round trips are no longer capped by the old 4-trades-per-5-days rule.
limitations: Read the primary FINRA Regulatory Notice 26-10 directly before relying on this for an actual execution-policy decision; this source is a secondary summary, not the regulatory text itself.
